name: fleet
description: Per project: a roster of permanent background sessions started with /fleet up from a template, each seeded, budgeted, paced by a cadence and placed in the panel; they ask you without stopping and you answer from any session with /fleet, at no token cost; a send to a third party through the tools and commands fleet recognises waits for your approval of the exact draft (a script that sends by itself isn't seen); a session that read outside content is marked, and command-level files change only when you apply a drafted change or ask for it yourself; mail and chat dropped in the inbox are read once each by a small model as data, written as records and routed by tags, and a mail asking for a change becomes one you confirm with its diff; alerts reach you by push, a mail to yourself or a script; derived documents are refreshed when what they cite is revised; scarce resources are taken in turn; judges propose an answer to each question from your past answers, your principles and the no's you said, never on money, the outside world or what can't be undone, and /fleet stats shows how often you agree; in an area you turn live they answer what your record settles, labelled, and /fleet overrule corrects them; a stale write of a shared file is refused once; an instance hears when upstream (git, or Perforce through ssh) changed a file it changed or has open, and its row is marked until it rebased or synced; findings and results carry a proof or are marked unproven; /fleet up --wave n shows what the earlier waves landed; /fleet brief shows the project at a glance
